curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can an educator's unconventional tactics truly bridge the divide and turn written-off teenagers into the country's top calculus students?
curatedMovie.description: In a Hispanic neighborhood high school, mathematics teacher Jaime Escalante refuses to write off his struggling students, using unorthodox methods to push them toward advanced algebra and calculus.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Thoughtful, emotionally resonant, and steadily paced. An engaging drama well suited for a family night.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This drama follows a mathematics teacher using unconventional methods to help students reach advanced algebra and calculus.
